chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'a, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): he said,
'I asked him about the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
"And whoever kills a believer deliberately, his punishment is Hell, abiding eternally in it."
He said: The one who kills a believer on account of his religion — that is the deliberate killer whom God, Mighty and Majestic, speaks of, and He has prepared for him a great punishment.

I said: What of a man between whom and another man something happens, so he strikes him with his sword and kills him? He said: That is not the deliberate (killer) whom God, Mighty and Majestic, speaks of.

key_terms.الْمُتَعَمِّدُ: the deliberate (killer) — specifically one who kills a believer because of their religion
key_terms.عَذَابًا عَظِيمًا: great punishment — Quranic expression for severe divine retribution
key_terms.عَلَى دِينِهِ: on account of his religion — the motive that defines the worst form of murder

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about deliberate killing of a believer in Quran 4:93?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets Quran 4:93 to distinguish between religiously motivated murder — killing a believer because of their faith — and killing that arises from personal dispute. Only the former constitutes the 'deliberate killing' condemned by God as warranting eternal punishment in Hell. This distinction reflects early Shia jurisprudential reasoning about the gravity of apostasy-motivated murder versus ordinary homicide in a fit of anger or conflict.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic

[4:93] And whoever kills a Believer deliberately, his Punishment is Hell; he shall abide in it eternally, said: ‘The one who kills a Believer upon his Religion, so that is the deliberation which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Speaks of

and Prepare for him a Painful Punishment’. I said, ‘So what happens if something takes place between two persons, so he strikes him with his sword, so he kills him?’ Heasws said: ‘That is not the deliberation (pre-meditated killer) whom Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Speaks of’.
